release.name: cloud-results-40375727831-1-tx-phase-reset334-tail-m4-physical
release.body: Reserved exact-source evidence for one two-polarity native qualification of exactly12 existing PLL tail M4 branch width changes per polarity. Exact current407-file AVSS18 baseline, complete material preservation/40 faults,334-device deep/flat LVS/560-category DRC and1010-terminal gates remain required. No RC extraction, simulation, electrical/full PHY or chip timing acceptance. No automatic retry.
